task: Write save_catalog(products: list[dict], path) and load_catalog(path) for the marketplace product catalog, stored as JSON on disk. Product names and descriptions come from sellers all over the world.

constraints.text: catalog JSON gets written with ensure_ascii=False so names stay human-readable on disk
constraints.why: backslash-u escapes tripled the catalog file size and made the 2026-03 translator diff review unreadable

constraints.text: catalog writes pass sort_keys=True so nightly exports diff cleanly
constraints.why: unsorted dumps churned thousands of diff lines a night and buried a real price change during the 2026-05 audit
